config.reader_selection: Original completed KL-only Reader, fixed epoch4/step1024; taskCEKL Reader explicitly excluded.
config.quantizer: Fixed shared asymmetric FP16 min/range; K grouped over64 transmitted source positions per channel, V over64 channels per token. Identical quantization ranges for INT4 and INT8; per-token bit allocation. KIVI-inspired axes, NOT an unmodified KIVI/KVTuner reproduction.
config.wire_policy: Unique original Sender positions used by the existing Full-Sync map. Quantize once before alignment expansion. Same decoded tensors replace those positions in native Llama or feed the fixed Translator after original map. Other native cache positions / Qwen anchor unchanged.
config.scope: 128 previously unseen 2Wiki controlled evidence questions, oracle supporting sentences plus8 distractors; exploratory diagnostic, not official full-context benchmark.
config.ranking: FP16 Llama last forced-prefix query, query-head/layer mean projected to evidence text units then to original transmitted Llama token positions. No gold answer in ranking; top/bottom/random protect identical ceil(0.1*Nwire) evidence-overlapping positions across all layers/KV heads and K,V.
config.bytes: Actual packed packet length including FP16 quantization min/range, bitmask, source positions, receiver mapping, dimensions and section lengths. C/D/E exact byte matched; INT4 is lower-budget reference.

minmax_axes: Key: token groups64; Value: channel groups64
